bundle.shortDescription: Build. Manage. Ship. — every GitHub repository in one desktop app.
bundle.longDescription: ZIT-Suite is a free, open-source GitHub desktop client and repository manager. Manage hundreds of repositories at once with bulk actions and a real dry run, triage issues and pull requests across all of them, watch GitHub Actions, ship releases, review security alerts, edit files and work with local projects through built-in Git — no terminal needed.
